title: Kali Linux Portfolio
description: An interactive Linux-style workstation in the browser: windows, an application launcher, developer utilities and educational security simulations.
problem: Make an engineering portfolio something visitors can explore, not just read.
architecture: A Next.js host coordinates a central window manager, persistent workspace state and a dynamically imported application registry.
tradeoff: The desktop offers depth; lightweight reading routes make the work accessible without booting or managing windows.

title: Web Crawler Studio
description: A local-first TypeScript workspace for exploring pages, links, images and site structure across HTML and JavaScript-rendered websites.
problem: Turn a bounded website crawl into an inspectable inventory rather than an opaque list of URLs.
architecture: Fast HTTP retrieval can escalate sparse application shells to Chromium. The workspace separates page inventory, link graphs, rendering evidence and export.
tradeoff: Browser rendering captures more dynamic content but costs time and memory. Smart mode preserves raw results and reports rendering failures rather than disguising them as success.

title: Webflyx RAG Studio
description: A Windows-first retrieval lab that combines keyword, semantic and image search with source-grounded question answering over a movie corpus.
problem: Explore how retrieval choices affect the context supplied to a language model.
architecture: BM25 and embedding search feed reciprocal-rank fusion, with optional cross-encoder reranking. CLIP supports image-to-text retrieval; model embeddings are cached locally.
tradeoff: Retrieval works without an LLM key. Generative features are optional and send selected context to OpenRouter only when invoked; model availability and loading remain explicit constraints.

title: IIS Hardener GUI
description: A PowerShell and WinForms engineering lab for IIS assessment, selected hardening changes, HTML reports and configuration backup/restore.
problem: Make server configuration review and rollback visible in one local administration interface.
architecture: Separate assessment, hardening and backup tabs expose IIS inventory, selected configuration changes and appcmd backup/restore.
tradeoff: Server-wide changes require administrative access and staging validation. This portfolio links to the source; it does not run the tool or change a visitor's system.

title: GPT Researcher · fork
description: A fork of the upstream autonomous research project. Included for provenance, not presented as an original implementation or an upstream contribution.
problem: Keep exploratory forks separate from independently maintained portfolio projects.
architecture: The original research-agent architecture belongs to the upstream project.
tradeoff: A fork alone is not evidence of authorship or of an accepted contribution. No such contribution is claimed here.
